prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW aquarium game asset, not the reference character. Match the REFERENCE illustration's friendly CARTOON visual language: chunky rounded simplified silhouette, strong clean dark brown outlines, bold appealing shapes, expressive oversized glossy eyes if the animal has eyes, warm layered hand-painted cel shading and broad clean highlights. Cute stylized mobile-game character, NOT scientific drawing, realistic rendering, fine anatomical filaments or washed-out watercolor. No otter traits or otter accessories. Subject: An ornate EPIC DREAMING DUMBO OCTOPUS, adorable lavender and midnight violet rounded head with big ear-like fins, sleepy closed eyes, eight short arms linked by softly translucent webbing, intricate glowing silver dream constellation patterns, tiny pearl ornaments along fin edges, pastel opal underside suckers and subtle gold details. Fancy rich texture and luminous layered fins. Front upright view, no clothes or hat. Front or top three-quarter view, upright, same orientation throughout. Maintain cute cartoon foundation. EPIC grade: visibly luxurious intricate luminous patterns, jewel/pearl highlights, layered fins and rich color depth, considerably more ornate and detailed while keeping cartoon silhouette. OUTPUT a square 2x2 ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET: four equal square cells edge-to-edge, exactly ONE same character in each cell. Use thumbnail reference as exact character identity, same size and position relative to each cell. Four subtle body gently contracting and relaxing, fins and arms folding then opening phases. Each creature occupies central 68% of its cell with generous padding, no body turning or translation. Grid must have no visible lines. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, words, watermarks, grid, labels.
padding_fix_prompt: Edit this 2x2 animation sheet ONLY to fix frame padding. Preserve the exact same ornate cartoon animal identity, colors, face, beautiful details and all four animation poses. Make EACH animal HALF its current size, including ALL fins, tail, beads and tentacles. Keep four equal square cells. Centers exactly at 25%,25%;75%,25%;25%,75%;75%,75%. Each full animal bounding box must fit in 27% of TOTAL canvas width and height (=54% of a cell). Vast transparent padding all around EACH animal. Central vertical band x=42% to58% and central horizontal band y=42% to58% must be COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent. At least 10% of outer canvas borders blank transparent. Four SMALL complete animals with broad empty gutters, no grid lines, no text, no bubbles or shadows. Actual alpha transparency. Do NOT zoom in to fill the canvas. Animation must be sliceable at exact midlines with no cut fins, tails or rays.
